# Endorsal

Endorsal automates the collection and display of customer testimonials and reviews, enhancing social proof for businesses.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/endorsal/.

## Actions

- **Create Testimonial**: Submit a new testimonial.
- **Get Testimonial** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific testimonial by its unique identifier.
- **Get AutoRequest Campaign** (read-only): Retrieve a specific autorequest campaign by its unique identifier.
- **Get Contact** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific contact by its unique identifier.
- **Get Tag** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific tag by its unique identifier.
- **Get Widget** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific widget by its unique identifier.
- **List AutoRequest Campaigns** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all autorequest campaigns.
- **List Contact Testimonials** (read-only): Retrieve all testimonials submitted by a specific contact.
- **List Contacts** (read-only): Retrieve all contacts associated with your account.
- **List Properties** (read-only): Retrieve all properties for the authenticated account.
- **List Tag Testimonials** (read-only): Retrieve all testimonials for a given tag.
- **List Tags** (read-only): Retrieve all tags for a specific property.
- **List Widgets** (read-only): Retrieve all widgets associated with your account.
